about.title: West Hollywood Car Accident Claims
about.longDescription: West Hollywood's dense nightlife corridors and steady weekend traffic on Santa Monica Boulevard, Sunset Boulevard, Fountain Avenue, and La Cienega Boulevard mean collisions happen more often than most residents expect. Recent public records show 271 injury collisions and 338 injured people in a single year, with reported crashes tending to cluster around Sunday early-morning hours. If you were hurt in one of these crashes, what happens in the days right after matters. Insurance adjusters move fast, sometimes asking for recorded statements before you've even seen a doctor. Our team handles personal injury claims in West Hollywood. We can evaluate your situation, explain your options under California law, and handle communications with insurers on your behalf. Your initial consultation is free, and we only get paid if you recover compensation.
commonInjuries: Cuts and lacerations from broken glass or debris

whyChoose.title: What Matters After a West Hollywood Car Accident

items.title: The Clock Is Already Running
items.desc: California generally gives you two years from the crash date to file a car accident claim, but if a government vehicle or road defect was involved, that window can shrink to as little as six months. Talking with us early helps make sure a deadline doesn't quietly close on you.

items.title: Fault Doesn't Have to Be All-or-Nothing
items.desc: Under California's pure comparative fault rule, you can still recover compensation even if you were partly responsible for the crash — your share of fault simply reduces the amount, it doesn't erase your claim. We can help make sure fault is assessed fairly rather than assumed against you.

items.title: No Fee Unless You Recover
items.desc: We work on contingency, meaning there's no upfront cost and no fee unless your case results in a recovery. This lets you focus on medical care instead of worrying about legal bills.

items.question: Should I give a recorded statement to the other driver's insurance company?
items.answer: It's generally wise to avoid giving a recorded statement before speaking with an attorney, since insurers often use these statements to minimize what they owe. We can advise you on what you're required to share and what can wait.

items.question: What if my accident happened near Santa Monica Boulevard or Sunset Boulevard late at night?
items.answer: West Hollywood sees a noticeable share of reported crashes on Sundays between midnight and 2 a.m., often tied to nightlife traffic along these corridors. Regardless of when or where it happened, preserving evidence like photos, witness contacts, and any available surveillance footage early can make a real difference later.

items.question: How long do I have to file a claim after a car accident in California?
items.answer: California's statute of limitations is typically two years from the date of the crash for injury claims, though claims involving a government entity can require notice in as little as six months. Because these timelines vary by situation, it's worth confirming your specific deadline with us sooner rather than later.
